notes: Measured on BV12beJ69E8W (online-client game), NOT copied from the offline round-table layout: the subtitle bar sits 58 px higher (y=842 vs 900) and the label box is wider (382 vs 256 px). See scripts/probe_layout.py output under runs/_layout_probe/.
This edit is a teaching video and prints answer-bearing text in three places. Two are handled here; the third is handled by the run interval.

(1) The speaker label box carries the protagonist's ROLE and the Percival thumb-card marker: '9号 陈述句 派西维尔', '6号 Nancy 拇指牌'. The box is centre-aligned, so no fixed sub-rect isolates the seat. `redact: keep_first_ink_run` keeps only the leading '<n>号' token; the nickname and role are blanked before OCR, diffing, cache keys and saved crops.
(2) The bottom seat strip shows every seat's role from the assassination phase onward, so it is private, never public.

(3) Full-screen editorial cards ('派西维尔', '拇指牌为2号和6号') live in the camera area, which is excluded. Bar-less outlined subtitles in the caption band can still restate them, so subtitle_plain captions need review before they count as in-game speech.

The right column is the game client, not a physical board: it prints '<n>号队长提名 → a·b·c', '否决组队 x:y', '通过组队 x:y', '自动通过' (the forced proposal), per-seat vote chips, '任务投票: 成功 m · 失败 n', the Lady of the Lake result and the end-of-game banner. It is parsed by vbench/client_log.py, not by board.py.

subtitle_plain caught 84 of 623 captions (13.5%) in BV12beJ69E8W — real speech in a pale-bar/outlined style the strict yellow gate misses. Measuring only the main bar would have silently dropped all of them.

regions.why: Burned-in subtitle on the yellow bar.
